package.author: Steve the Killer
package.description: Encrypted calendar for Windows. Install or run portable. GPLv3. No account, no sync, no telemetry.

en-US.author: Steve the Killer
en-US.description: Encrypted calendar for Windows. Install or run portable. GPLv3. No account, no sync, no telemetry.
en-US.longDescription: Killendar keeps your appointments in a single file on your own machine, with optional SQLCipher AES-256 encryption at rest once you set a password. Month, week, day and agenda views, color categories, recurring appointments, and iCalendar import and export. Unlocked it is an ordinary SQLite database you can read, back up, or copy to another machine. Runs portable or installs for you or every user - no account, no sync, no telemetry. Open source under GPLv3.
en-US.name: Killendar
en-US.releaseNotes:
Killendar 1.4.2 fixes first-time installs, which 1.4.1 refused.
Fixed
- Installing Killendar on a PC that does not have it yet works again, from the install prompt, winget, Chocolatey or any other silent install. 1.4.1 refused its own signed installer with "The update signer is not trusted by this development build" (exit 1625). Installs over an existing copy were not affected.
